## Hi, I’m **Sadhana!** 👋  
[Download My CV Here!](Sadhana%20R%20Sambandam%20CV.pdf)

I’m in my final year studying International Business with French at DCU, specializing in Data Analytics. Right now, I represent over 5,000 students as the Business Faculty Rep in DCUSU, a role that’s taught me a lot about leadership, listening, and speaking up for change.

Outside the classroom, I’m all about startups, strategy, AI, ethics, sustainability, and entrepreneurship. Basically, if it’s at the edge of innovation and has real-world impact, I’m in, driven by curiosity and passion.

## What drives me?  
I’m a firm believer in big ideas, bold thinking, and the power of innovation. Whether it’s solving real-world business challenges, exploring the intersection of AI and ethics, or reimagining sustainable solutions, I am constantly learning, creating, and pushing boundaries .  

I love big questions. How can we make AI more ethical? What does a sustainable business future look like? How do we build things that actually make life better? I’m always chasing ideas, experimenting, and trying to connect the dots between technology and human values.

## What you’ll find here  

-  [My Portfolio](portfolio.html) – Projects, achievements, and insights into my career.  
-  [My Blog](blog.html) – A space where I share my thoughts on books, business, AI, and innovation. From my artwork to travel experiences, discoveries, and lessons learned along the way.  

## Where I’m headed  
Long term, I want to be part of shaping the future of responsible tech. I’m aiming for a master’s, then a PhD in Sustainable AI and Ethics, and one day, I hope to teach and mentor others as a university professor.

This site is a little window into the things I care about and the path I’m on.
I’m here to *learn, grow, and make a difference*, one idea, one challenge, and one adventure at a time.  

Welcome to my world.
